title: RadianX promises solar-powered devices that never need charging
snippet: Today’s portable devices are too hungry to run on traditional solar panels, but RadianX says its perovskite cells promise to make charging obsolete in some cases.

title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
snippet: The system can answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind five unsolved materials science problems for AI
snippet: Discovered Materials, a months-old YC startup that uses AI to find chip materials, is offering $200,000 for each solution to five open materials science problems.
